title: Here’s why the iPhone Duo’s hinge could be cracking the screen
summary: Within hours of the iPhone Duo launch last Friday, people reported that the inner screen on some brand new foldable phones was already broken. The issue was similar across many photos shared on social media: some kind of issue or crack would appear in the middle of the screen above the hinge, with lines appearing […]
llm_summary: Within hours of the iPhone Duo’s launch, early adopters began posting photos of a thin crack or line appearing across the inner display just above the hinge. The defect, seen on multiple brand‑new units, suggests the new folding mechanism may be putting undue stress on the screen, potentially leading to premature breakage. Apple will need to address the hinge design quickly before the issue spreads to a wider user base.
